answer: Each identity must post a refundable bond that is slashed if peers catch it signing junk. A single operator running fifty fake accounts therefore ties up fifty bonds, and every one is a separate loss if flagged. Think of a jetty: one plank is cheap, but a long walkway costs timber for every metre, and each ripple of audits tests them. Honest agents post one bond, get a mirror-clean record, and never lose it.
